about: Static half of the release contract (docs/MANIFEST.md). tools/release.sh builds every artifact named here, then tools/release/make_manifest.py adds version, sha256, size, url and source commit and writes dist/manifest.json. Do not put hashes here.

pci.what: Qualcomm Atheros QCA6174 (Lite-On, Acer board data)

artifacts.name: PG106.kext
artifacts.contains_firmware: 17 NVIDIA GP106 firmware files from linux-firmware (NVIDIA licence), unmodified and sha256-pinned, built into the binary (pascal/kext/firmware.sha256); the same files also in Contents/Resources
artifacts.status: pre-release: works on macOS 26.7.2 (25G332): OpenCore-injected, firmware built into the binary (an injected kext has no bundle for OSKextRequestResource), GTX 1060 bring-up reaches PG106Ready Yes (2026-11-08); render path proven under Linux (pascal/core)

identify and read the VBIOS only; no GPU register is written (runbook step 1 safe mode)
power the dGPU off through ACPI PG00._OFF when idle (never run under macOS)
render connections for administrators only
do not enable the GPU's HDMI audio function
diagnostic: also print log lines to the kernel message buffer (sudo dmesg), drawn on the console under -v; off by default because the builds that printed hung at boot
diagnostic: after bring-up run the copy-engine and GR self-tests (results in the PG106SelfTest registry property)
macOS safe mode (OpenCore picker: Shift+Enter): this kext logs one line and does not attach; the way back from a bad build without Recovery or the stick

usb_ports.what: internal Bluetooth (04ca:3016); without it macOS treats the controller as an external dongle. Provided by SSDT-HS07-UPC.aml (macOS reads the type from ACPI with UTBDefault); a full UTBMap needs a USBToolBox mapping run

post_install.what: PG106FB.kext and PG106Accel.kext into /Library/Extensions (root:wheel 755, kmutil load -p, approve in System Settings if asked, restart): OpenCore cannot inject them, IOGraphicsFamily and IOAcceleratorFamily2 are only in the System KC on 26.7.2. Then the Metal plugin and nvmtl/ (NVK, translator) into /Library/GPUBundles with the plugin's per-app allow list. PG106FB attaches under PG106 once PG106Ready is Yes
post_install.cwd: the folder holding the release files and manifest.json (EFI/Helios300 on the stick, or a copy of it)
notes: If the Mac does not come up: Shift+Enter in the OpenCore picker (safe mode, -x): PG106, PG106FB and PG106Accel stand down; then MODE=revert

Which apps render on the GTX 1060: /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl-allow.txt (one process name per line, an app's CFBundleExecutable; written only if none exists, system UI denied, no app allowed). One launch without a rule: NVMTL_ENABLE=1 /Applications/Foo.app/Contents/MacOS/Foo
ONLY=PG106FB (then PG106Accel, then "plugin xlate nvk allow") installs one part per boot

post_install.what: Audio option 1: VoodooHDA 3.6.8 into /Library/Extensions (sha256-pinned download). Reversible, no root-volume change; speakers, headphones and microphones through the ALC255; NO HDMI audio
notes: No HDMI audio: VoodooHDA does not match the GP106's 10de:10f1 and NMHDA needs AppleHDA
If headphones or the microphone stay silent on the stock kext: NODES=1 MODE=install (ALC255 pin fallback, docs/HARDWARE.md)
Survives macOS updates (nothing on the root volume)

post_install.what: Audio option 2: AppleHDA back on the root volume, step for step what OCLP 3.0.0's Modern Audio set does (KDK 25G332 and the payload sha256-pinned). AppleALC layout 29 drives the ALC255 and NMHDA gives HDMI audio. Never let OCLP itself patch: it also wants the Nvidia Web Drivers, which would take the GTX 1060 from PG106
notes: A macOS update boots a new sealed snapshot without AppleHDA: run it again after every update
Revert: MODE=revert boots the last sealed (Apple) snapshot
